stories.headline: Google backs European AI science with models
stories.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud will give up to 200 European researchers access to frontier models plus $3M in compute credits.
stories.why_it_matters: Big new compute access for European AI-for-science work.

stories.headline: Google funds AI weather research in Ireland
stories.summary: Google.org announced a $5M commitment for AI-powered weather forecasting and climate research, including support for UCD-linked partners.
stories.why_it_matters: Climate and public-safety AI gets fresh research funding.

stories.headline: Google expands AI help for disease research
stories.summary: Google says it is using AI tools and open platforms to accelerate medical research, from brain mapping to faster genetic analysis.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows more AI-for-health deployment and research support.
